mainEntity.name: Which F-Type engines do you work on?

acceptedAnswer.text: We work on the F-Type 2.0 P300, 3.0 V6 supercharged and 5.0 V8 supercharged engines, in both Coupe and Convertible models.

mainEntity.name: How much is a Jaguar F-Type engine replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on the engine type, unit availability and labour required. We provide a quote after assessing your F-Type rather than a fixed price.

mainEntity.name: Can you supply a Jaguar F-Type reconditioned engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Where replacement is the better option, we can supply and fit a reconditioned engine matched to your F-Type's engine code.

mainEntity.name: Do you have a Jaguar F-Type engine for sale in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can source reconditioned F-Type engines depending on availability. Contact us with your registration, and we will check suitable options for your car.

mainEntity.name: Does a misfire mean my F-Type needs a rebuild?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. Misfires can come from ignition, fuel or mechanical causes. A diagnostic check is needed before any rebuild is considered.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Jaguar F-Type engine rebuild take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timescales depend on the fault, parts availability and machining required. We will give you an estimated timeframe after the engine has been assessed.

mainEntity.name: Can you collect my F-Type from anywhere in the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We offer collection and delivery across the UK from our Essex workshop, so you can reach us wherever you are.
